payload.query: Build me a laddered bond portfolio for a 5-year horizon using investment-grade securities only.

payload.analysis: We recommend a laddered bond portfolio with exposure across 3-5 years. The portfolio will consist of bonds with a mix of near-term and longer-term maturities to provide a smooth cash flow profile over the next 5 years. A laddered structure limits the exposure to any one particular year, which aligns with our strategy of managing fixed-income allocation to provide portfolio stability and capital preservation. For the 5-year horizon, we will focus on investment-grade corporate bonds with a mix of high-grade and high-yield securities to optimize returns within the credit quality and duration constraints. Specifically, we have identified a laddered maturity structure with three buckets: 2026 (3 years), 2028 (4 years), and 2031 (5 years). This spread-out approach ensures that no more than 30% of the portfolio matures in any single year, thereby minimizing concentration risk.
